declarations.name: ImbalancedChen.mem_historicalUpperFiveFrontierTuples_iff_log_on_cell
declarations.source_type:
theorem mem_historicalUpperFiveFrontierTuples_iff_log_on_cell
    (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (hab : D.a ≤ D.b)
    (hold : 0 < D.old) (hcheck : D.levelCheck = true)
    (N cap : ℕ) (hN : 1 < N)
    (hcap : (N : ℝ) ^ (D.b : ℝ) ≤ (cap : ℝ))
    (p : Fin 5 → ℕ) (j : Fin 5 → Fin (D.m + 1))
    (ht : actualPrimeTupleLog N p ∈
      logPrimeMeshCell (D.a : ℝ) (D.b : ℝ) D.m j) :
    p ∈ firstExitFrontierTuples 4 (D.upperThirdPolicy (N : ℝ))
        (roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 ((N : ℝ) ^ (D.b : ℝ))) ↔
      StrictAnti p ∧
        (∀ i, Nat.Prime (p i) ∧ ¬p i ∣ N ∧
          0 ≤ (p i : ℝ) ∧ (p i : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) ^ (D.b : ℝ)) ∧
        3 * actualPrimeTupleLog N p 0 < (D.old : ℝ) ∧
          actualPrimeTupleLog N p 0 + actualPrimeTupleLog N p 1 +
            3 * actualPrimeTupleLog N p 2 <
              (D.cell3 (historicalPrefixProject (by omega : 3 ≤ 5) j) : ℝ)
declarations.elaborated_type:
∀ (D : ImbalancedChen.HistoricalPrefixCapData),
  D.a ≤ D.b →
    0 < D.old →
      D.levelCheck = true →
        ∀ (N cap : ℕ),
          1 < N →
            ↑N ^ ↑D.b ≤ ↑cap →
              ∀ (p : Fin 5 → ℕ) (j : Fin 5 → Fin (D.m + 1)),
                ImbalancedChen.actualPrimeTupleLog N p ∈ ImbalancedChen.logPrimeMeshCell (↑D.a) (↑D.b) D.m j →
                  (p ∈
                      ImbalancedChen.firstExitFrontierTuples 4 (D.upperThirdPolicy ↑N)
                        (ImbalancedChen.roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 (↑N ^ ↑D.b)) ↔
                    StrictAnti p ∧
                      (∀ (i : Fin 5), Nat.Prime (p i) ∧ ¬p i ∣ N ∧ 0 ≤ ↑(p i) ∧ ↑(p i) < ↑N ^ ↑D.b) ∧
                        3 * ImbalancedChen.actualPrimeTupleLog N p 0 < ↑D.old ∧
                          ImbalancedChen.actualPrimeTupleLog N p 0 + ImbalancedChen.actualPrimeTupleLog N p 1 +
                              3 * ImbalancedChen.actualPrimeTupleLog N p 2 <
                            ↑(D.cell3 (ImbalancedChen.historicalPrefixProject ⋯ j)))

declarations.source_type:
theorem historicalUpperFiveFrontierTuples_cell_filter
    (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (hab : D.a < D.b)
    (hold : 0 < D.old) (hcheck : D.levelCheck = true)
    (N cap : ℕ) (hN : 1 < N)
    (hcap : (N : ℝ) ^ (D.b : ℝ) ≤ (cap : ℝ))

    (firstExitFrontierTuples 4 (D.upperThirdPolicy (N : ℝ))
      (roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 ((N : ℝ) ^ (D.b : ℝ)))).filter
        (fun p => actualPrimeTupleLog N p ∈
          logPrimeMeshCell (D.a : ℝ) (D.b : ℝ) D.m j) =
      (actualPrimeBoxTuples N (fun _ : Fin 5 => (D.a : ℝ))
        (fun _ => (D.b : ℝ))).filter
        (fun p => actualPrimeTupleLog N p ∈
          logPrimeMeshCell (D.a : ℝ) (D.b : ℝ) D.m j ∩
            primeAffineGateRegion ordinaryUpperFiveGateForms
              (D.fifthParentGateBounds j))
declarations.elaborated_type:
∀ (D : ImbalancedChen.HistoricalPrefixCapData),
  D.a < D.b →
    0 < D.old →
      D.levelCheck = true →
        ∀ (N cap : ℕ),
          1 < N →
            ↑N ^ ↑D.b ≤ ↑cap →
              ∀ (j : Fin 5 → Fin (D.m + 1)),
                {p ∈
                      ImbalancedChen.firstExitFrontierTuples 4 (D.upperThirdPolicy ↑N)
                        (ImbalancedChen.roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 (↑N ^ ↑D.b)) |
                    ImbalancedChen.actualPrimeTupleLog N p ∈ ImbalancedChen.logPrimeMeshCell (↑D.a) (↑D.b) D.m j} =
                  {p ∈ ImbalancedChen.actualPrimeBoxTuples N (fun x => ↑D.a) fun x => ↑D.b |
                    ImbalancedChen.actualPrimeTupleLog N p ∈
                      ImbalancedChen.logPrimeMeshCell (↑D.a) (↑D.b) D.m j ∩
                        ImbalancedChen.primeAffineGateRegion ImbalancedChen.ordinaryUpperFiveGateForms
                          (D.fifthParentGateBounds j)}

theorem fifthCellPrimeCorrection_eq_residual_sums (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData)
    (hab : D.a < D.b) (hold : 0 < D.old) (hcheck : D.levelCheck = true)
    (N cap : ℕ) (hN : 1 < N)
    (hcap : (N : ℝ) ^ (D.b : ℝ) ≤ (cap : ℝ))
    (j : Fin 5 → Fin (D.m + 1)) (hj : j ∈ D.cells5) :
    D.fifthCellPrimeCorrection N cap j =
      actualPrimeBoxOwnCubeMinusSum 4 N cap (D.a : ℝ) (D.b : ℝ) (D.cap5 j : ℝ)
        (logPrimeMeshCell (D.a : ℝ) (D.b : ℝ) D.m j ∩
          primeAffineGateRegion ordinaryUpperFiveGateForms (D.fifthParentGateBounds j)) -
      actualPrimeBoxOwnCubeMinusSum 4 N cap (D.a : ℝ) (D.b : ℝ) (D.old5 j : ℝ)
        (logPrimeMeshCell (D.a : ℝ) (D.b : ℝ) D.m j ∩
          primeAffineGateRegion ordinaryUpperFiveGateForms (D.fifthParentGateBounds j))
declarations.elaborated_type:
∀ (D : ImbalancedChen.HistoricalPrefixCapData),
  D.a < D.b →
    0 < D.old →
      D.levelCheck = true →
        ∀ (N cap : ℕ),
          1 < N →
            ↑N ^ ↑D.b ≤ ↑cap →
              ∀ j ∈ D.cells5,
                D.fifthCellPrimeCorrection N cap j =
                  ImbalancedChen.actualPrimeBoxOwnCubeMinusSum 4 N cap (↑D.a) (↑D.b) (↑(D.cap5 j))
                      (ImbalancedChen.logPrimeMeshCell (↑D.a) (↑D.b) D.m j ∩
                        ImbalancedChen.primeAffineGateRegion ImbalancedChen.ordinaryUpperFiveGateForms
                          (D.fifthParentGateBounds j)) -
                    ImbalancedChen.actualPrimeBoxOwnCubeMinusSum 4 N cap (↑D.a) (↑D.b) (↑(D.old5 j))
                      (ImbalancedChen.logPrimeMeshCell (↑D.a) (↑D.b) D.m j ∩
                        ImbalancedChen.primeAffineGateRegion ImbalancedChen.ordinaryUpperFiveGateForms
                          (D.fifthParentGateBounds j))

            (ImbalancedChen.primeOwnCubeGatedProfile (↑(D.cap5 j)) t -

    (ha : 0 < D.a) (hab : D.a < D.b) (hold : 0 < D.old)

declarations.name: ImbalancedChen.HistoricalPrefixCapData.actualHistoricalFifthSaving_eq_tupleSum_at_cutoff
declarations.source_type:
theorem actualHistoricalFifthSaving_eq_tupleSum_at_cutoff
    (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (N cap : ℕ) (z : ℝ) :
    actualHistoricalFifthSaving
        (ordinaryParityRosserPolicy false ((N : ℝ) ^ (D.old : ℝ)))
        (D.level3 (N : ℝ)) (D.level4 (N : ℝ)) (D.level5 (N : ℝ)) N cap z *
        Real.log (N : ℝ) / singularSeries N =
      ∑ p ∈ firstExitFrontierTuples 4 (D.upperThirdPolicy (N : ℝ))
        (roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 z),
        (∏ i, 1 / ((p i : ℝ) - 1)) * D.fifthTupleOwnCubeDifference N cap p
declarations.elaborated_type:
∀ (D : ImbalancedChen.HistoricalPrefixCapData) (N cap : ℕ) (z : ℝ),
  ImbalancedChen.actualHistoricalFifthSaving (ImbalancedChen.ordinaryParityRosserPolicy false (↑N ^ ↑D.old))
          (D.level3 ↑N) (D.level4 ↑N) (D.level5 ↑N) N cap z *
        Real.log ↑N /
      ImbalancedChen.singularSeries N =
    ∑
      p ∈
        ImbalancedChen.firstExitFrontierTuples 4 (D.upperThirdPolicy ↑N) (ImbalancedChen.roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 z),
      (∏ i, 1 / (↑(p i) - 1)) * D.fifthTupleOwnCubeDifference N cap p

declarations.name: ImbalancedChen.HistoricalPrefixCapData.upperFourthToFifthSaving_eq
declarations.source_type:
theorem upperFourthToFifthSaving_eq (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData)
    (hab : D.a ≤ D.b) (hcheck : D.levelCheck = true)
    (N cap : ℕ) (hN : 1 < (N : ℝ)) (z : ℝ) :
    firstExitRetainedPolynomial (D.upperFourthPolicy (N : ℝ))
        (fun p : ℕ => 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) [] true 1 (roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 z) -
      firstExitRetainedPolynomial (D.upperFifthPolicy (N : ℝ))
        (fun p : ℕ => 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) [] true 1 (roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 z) =
      actualHistoricalFifthSaving
        (ordinaryParityRosserPolicy false ((N : ℝ) ^ (D.old : ℝ)))
        (D.level3 (N : ℝ)) (D.level4 (N : ℝ)) (D.level5 (N : ℝ)) N cap z

∀ (D : ImbalancedChen.HistoricalPrefixCapData),
  D.a ≤ D.b →
    D.levelCheck = true →
      ∀ (N cap : ℕ),
        1 < ↑N →
          ∀ (z : ℝ),
            ImbalancedChen.firstExitRetainedPolynomial (D.upperFourthPolicy ↑N) (fun p => 1 / (↑p - 1)) [] true 1
                  (ImbalancedChen.roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 z) -
                ImbalancedChen.firstExitRetainedPolynomial (D.upperFifthPolicy ↑N) (fun p => 1 / (↑p - 1)) [] true 1
                  (ImbalancedChen.roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 z) =
              ImbalancedChen.actualHistoricalFifthSaving (ImbalancedChen.ordinaryParityRosserPolicy false (↑N ^ ↑D.old))
                (D.level3 ↑N) (D.level4 ↑N) (D.level5 ↑N) N cap z

    (ha : 0 < D.a) (hab : D.a < D.b) (hold : 0 < D.old)

          (roughPrimeUniverse N (Nat.ceil ((N : ℝ) ^ (D.b : ℝ))) 0
            ((N : ℝ) ^ (D.b : ℝ))) -
        firstExitRetainedPolynomial (D.upperFifthPolicy (N : ℝ))
          (fun p : ℕ => 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) [] true 1
          (roughPrimeUniverse N (Nat.ceil ((N : ℝ) ^ (D.b : ℝ))) 0
            ((N : ℝ) ^ (D.b : ℝ)))) *
        Real.log (N : ℝ) / singularSeries N)
      (atTop ⊓ Filter.principal {N : ℕ | 0 < N ∧ Even N})
      (𝓝 D.fifthCorrectionIntegral)

  0 < D.a →

          Filter.Tendsto
            (fun N =>
              (ImbalancedChen.firstExitRetainedPolynomial (D.upperFourthPolicy ↑N) (fun p => 1 / (↑p - 1)) [] true 1
                      (ImbalancedChen.roughPrimeUniverse N ⌈↑N ^ ↑D.b⌉₊ 0 (↑N ^ ↑D.b)) -
                    ImbalancedChen.firstExitRetainedPolynomial (D.upperFifthPolicy ↑N) (fun p => 1 / (↑p - 1)) [] true 1
                      (ImbalancedChen.roughPrimeUniverse N ⌈↑N ^ ↑D.b⌉₊ 0 (↑N ^ ↑D.b))) *

                ImbalancedChen.actualPrimeTupleLog N p ∈ ImbalancedChen.logPrimeMeshCell a b m j} =
